My dear [Miss Frere](../persons.html#525)
You have chosen a very cold summer for your visit to England and I am afraid you must think you have come there in the winter by mistake.

We have had some revolutions in the state of the [Monthly Packet](../others.html#52), a new [partner](../persons.html#373) at [Mozley](../others.html#108)’s[^1] and a new printer, and my effort for some time past has been to get old material finished up. I have still so many verses on hand that I think I had better return yours.

For the story I think there will probably be room for it about July, if you feel able to go on with it.

Eleven months hence sounds a long allowance, but one has to live beforehand with magazines[^1]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: Although Augusta Frere signed several contributions of fiction to MP, and her cousin Emily Frere some non-fiction, the story is not identifiable.
